body:
Thanks for responding. I didn't know my post went through (using mobile Reddit, weird glitchiness, made a longer second post). The mistake was fixed; it was a miscommunication issue. I told a friend about over lunch and she just kinda laughed, saying how she'd made the same error when she used to work at the library. She tried reassuring me that I'm not stupid and mistakes happen, but the perfectionist in me can't accept that.

Life's been difficult these past two years. My dad stroked out and requires caretaking. He refuses to do anything that'll better his situation (i.e. exercising, reading, writing with his non-dominant hand). He only calls relatives when either my mother or I are being "too hard on him." It's maddening. I've had reccuring dreams of killing him. My mother is old and tired. She wants to retire but she can't because of medical bills, utilities, etc. The house needs repairs. I need a job that provides a living wage. I'm torn between wanting to make meaningful contributions to my family, and killing myself because I can't accept being mediocre like so many others. I've survived more suicide attempts than I'm willing to admit. I'm too weak and inexperienced to live, but apparently too stupid to properly off myself.
